standard.summary: 同时留在 GPU 的 FLUX.1 block 数，每个约 680MB 显存；默认 2。
standard.whenToUse: 仅在 FLUX Transformer Offload 为 block_residency 时生效；不确定时保持默认 2。
standard.avoidWhen: 16G 卡调到 4 个以上收益不大，只会多占显存。

standard_en.summary: How many FLUX.1 blocks stay on the GPU at once, about 680MB of VRAM each; default 2.
standard_en.whenToUse: Only applies when FLUX Transformer Offload is block_residency; keep the default of 2 when unsure.
standard_en.avoidWhen: On a 16GB card, going above 4 gains little and only takes more VRAM.

advanced.principle: 槽位是显存里同时驻留的 block 数，与电脑内存大小无关。默认 2 配合预取深度 1，在 16G 卡上显存池约 12.3GB。
advanced.tradeoffs: 槽位越多，可预取的 block 越多，但每多一个约多占 680MB 显存。

advanced_en.principle: Slots are blocks held in VRAM at the same time and do not depend on system RAM. The default of 2 with prefetch depth 1 keeps the pool near 12.3GB on a 16GB card.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: More slots allow more prefetched blocks, but each one costs about 680MB more VRAM.
